title: Bound the nonlinear echo on smooth planar preparation classes
statement: For velocity independent of x_i, transverse v obeys two-dimensional Navier-Stokes independently of A. Let S_v be its L2-contractive scalar propagator and f=[alpha_prime+lambda alpha]sin(kappa x_j)e_i with rational lambda approximating nu kappa^2. Exact Duhamel and four zero moments give ||U_i(5T)-U_i_unforced(5T)||2<=313 kappa B4 AT^5+12|lambda-nu kappa^2|AT, where B4=sup||d_s^4{S_v(5T,s)[v_j(s)cos(kappa x_j)]}||2. On uniformly smooth planar classes B4 is A-independent and AT^5=2^(-7n); a fixed positive unforced 2D smoothing interval gives the stated bounded-planar-H1 consequence with zero transverse disturbance. This is not a genuinely three-dimensional nonlinear estimate.
